violated_contract: The signed-in web shell (providers, sidebar, bottom bar, recording context) is one instance shared by every authenticated route; a route change must reconcile the page subtree in place. Keying the shell by pathname or registering a page with its own shell instance remounts the whole DOM on navigation, resetting scroll, discarding in-progress state such as an active recording, and reading as a page reload.
canonical_prevention: Register client routes with kind 'authenticated' so they ride the shared (authenticated) layout, and never key the persistent shell (or any provider-bearing ancestor) by pathname. A render test that changes the mocked pathname and asserts sidebar and bottom bar mount exactly once pins the contract.
